summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a remote-controlled PTY backdoor with Anthropic/Gemini credential harvesting
details: The npm tarball ships a 13MB Mach-O Go binary at bin/sxt built with github.com/creack/pty, github.com/coder/websocket, and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4. Embedded strings bind a hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install, giving a remote party interactive PTY control over the installer's host (network-driven remote shell). The same binary contains a regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} matching Anthropic API keys and references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, api.anthropic.com/v1/models, claude.ai, and Google Gemini CLI config paths, indicating extraction of installer-owned AI provider credentials. Additional strings reference shell history,.env files, and http://ip-api.com/json geolocation, co-located with the sextant.top relay, indicating bulk collection of installer environment and identity data for upload. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a publisher/repo name that openly advertises Claude-account control and does not correspond to a reputable Sextant-branded product.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
